purpose: Distilled, committed, per-workflow knowledge for pi-agent-ext-flux2-self-improve — pattern/lever/avoid/gotcha/false_positive/metric records loaded at Resolve (loadKnowledge) and rewritten at Persist (extractKnowledge). The committed, cross-machine superset of the ephemeral history/pi-agent-ext-flux2-self-improve/.
consumed_by: loadKnowledge() in pi-agent-ext-flux2-self-improve.js (Resolve) — injects active records' digest into the run. Also scripts/workflow-knowledge-manifest.mjs (the MANIFEST.md coverage matrix).

record_schema.name: type
record_schema.desc: pattern | lever | avoid | gotcha | false_positive | metric

record_schema.name: dimension
record_schema.desc: most-impacted metric dimension (e.g. quality.edge, voice.snr, composite) or null

record_schema.name: superseded_by
record_schema.desc: id of the replacing record, or null

record_schema.name: extracted_at
record_schema.desc: runId of the last extraction (NO Date.now — threaded from RUN_ID)

record_schema.name: condition
record_schema.desc: optional: knob→value map for the config held constant during this experiment (marks avoid/lever as conditional, not universal). null = universal finding.

findings: The ACTIVE records in THIS file are the findings (loadKnowledge filters status=active; superseded/retired are kept for audit but hidden). Raw per-run detail stays in the gitignored history/ dir.
notes: DIFFERENT artifact from per-model experiment logs (python/.../models/**/kb.jsonl), which are raw A/B measurements with their own kb.manifest.json. This file is GENERATED by scripts/kb-manifest-gen.mjs — do not hand-edit.
